{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSsE2AKtBjqzmWth68zx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnAmend.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transaction Amend\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn amend <id> <amount>`, which changes only a transaction's amount without leaving any account balance below zero. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-BalanceRule.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn amend |\n| Consumes | ledger_core.transactions, ledger_core.validation, ledger_core.balances, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAmend the amount of an existing transaction. Only the amount changes; date, account, category, and memo are untouched. Persistence is reached only through `ledger_core.transactions`, which calls the generated `persistence` package.\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Argument count other than two after `txn amend` exits 2.\n2. The id must be an integer; otherwise exit 3.\n3. The amount is validated with `ledger_core.validation` (`-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, at most two decimals, never zero); a violation exits 3.\n4. An absent id exits 4.\n5. The resulting balance of the transaction's account is the stored balance minus the old amount plus the new amount, computed in integer cents through `ledger_core.balances`. A negative result exits 3 and nothing is written.\n6. Otherwise only the amount is updated and the updated row is printed as `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` with a two-decimal amount.\n7. A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md and reached through `ledger_core.transactions`.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-amend-success ===\nIntent: Amending an existing transaction exits 0, prints the updated row with the supplied amount text, and a separate read shows the new integer cents.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nimport csv\nimport io\n\ndef f(row, name):\n    return row[name] if isinstance(row, dict) else getattr(row, name)\n\nacct, cat, tid = \"ZZAM1\", \"ZZAMC1\", 900100001\nday = \"2026-05-01\"\nnewtext = \"50.00\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"amend probe\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(tid), newtext)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n    assert rows[1][0] == str(tid)\n    assert rows[1][1] == day\n    assert rows[1][4] == newtext\n    assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid), \"amount\") == int(newtext.replace(\".\", \"\"))\n=== END AC txn-amend-success ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-only-amount ===\nIntent: Amend changes only the amount; date, account, category, and memo read back exactly as they were created.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(row, name):\n    return row[name] if isinstance(row, dict) else getattr(row, name)\n\nacct, cat, tid = \"ZZAM2\", \"ZZAMC2\", 900100002\nday = \"2026-05-02\"\nnote = \"keep this memo\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=2000, memo=note)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(tid), \"35.50\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    back = db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid)\n    assert f(back, \"date\") == day\n    assert f(back, \"account\") == acct\n    assert f(back, \"category\") == cat\n    assert f(back, \"memo\") == note\n=== END AC txn-amend-only-amount ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-absent ===\nIntent: Amending an id that does not exist exits 4, prints nothing to stdout, and creates no row.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ntid = 900199999\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid) is None\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(tid), \"5.00\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid) is None\n=== END AC txn-amend-absent ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-negative-balance ===\nIntent: An amend that would leave the account balance below zero exits 3 and keeps the original amount, while an amend landing exactly on zero succeeds. The account holds +10000 and -4000 cents, so lowering the first to 3000 gives -1000 and lowering it to 4000 gives 0.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(row, name):\n    return row[name] if isinstance(row, dict) else getattr(row, name)\n\nacct, cat = \"ZZAM3\", \"ZZAMC3\"\ntid_in, tid_out = 900100003, 900100004\ntoo_low, exact = \"30.00\", \"40.00\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid_in, date=\"2026-05-03\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid_out, date=\"2026-05-03\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-4000, memo=\"\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(tid_in), too_low)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid_in), \"amount\") == 10000\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(tid_in), exact)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n Validate before any write: the amount is positive with at most two decimals, the date is a real `YYYY-MM-DD` date, both accounts exist, they differ, and category `TRANSFER` exists. Both rows are inserted atomically and printed under the header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`.\n6. A failing command writes nothing to standard output and stores neither row.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md and reached through csv\nimport io\n\ndef f(row, name):\n    return row[name] if isinstance(row, dict) else getattr(row, name)\n\nsrc, dst, cat = \"ZZTF1\", \"ZZTF2\", \"TRANSFER\"\nday = \"2026-05-10\"\namount_text = \"250.00\"\ncents = int(amount_text.replace(\".\", \"\"))\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Source Account\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Dest Account\")\n    if db.categories.get(category=cat) is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=900300001, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=src, category=cat, amount=100000, memo=\"funding\")\n    before_max = max(f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", assert out_row[3] == cat and in_row[3] == cat\n    assert out_row[4] == \"-\" + amount_text\n    assert in_row[4] == amount_text\n    assert out_row[5] == \"transfer to \" + dst\n    assert in_row[5] == \"transfer from \" + src\n    assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(out_row[0])), \"amount\") == -cents\n    assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(in_row[0])), \"amount\") == cents\n=== END AC `txn_id`.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ReportBalances.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Balances\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Provides | ledger report balances |\n| Consumes | ledger_core.money, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nReport each account's transaction count and balance. Acceptance\n\n=== AC report-balances-values ===\nIntent: Each account row carries the count and formatted balance derived from stored transactions, and the TOTAL row carries the overall count and sum; expectations are computed from the stored rows.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nimport csv\nimport io\n\ndef f(row, name):\n    return row[name] if isinstance(row, dict) else getattr(row, name)\n\ndef fmt(c):\n    sign = \"-\" if c < 0 else \"\"\n    q, r = divmod(abs(c), 100)\n    return f\"{sign}{q}.{r:02d}\"\n\na1, a2, cat = \"ZZRB1\", \"ZZRB2\", \"ZZRBC1\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=a1, name=\"Report One\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=a2, name=\"Report Two\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Report Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=900400001, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=a1, category=cat, amount=123456, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=900400002, date=\"2026-05-02\", account=a1, category=cat, amount=-2345, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=900400003, date=\"2026-05-03\", account=a2, category=cat, amount=5, memo=\"\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    txns = db.transactions.list()\n    expected = []\n    for acc in sorted(db.accounts.list(), key=lambda r: f(r, \"account\")):\n        mine = [f(t, \"amount\") for t in txns if f(t, \"account\") == f(acc, \"account\")]\n        expected.append([f(acc, \"account\"), f(acc, \"name\"), str(len(mine)), fmt(sum(mine))])\n    expected.append([\"TOTAL\", \"\", str(len(txns)), fmt(sum(f(t, \"amount\") for t in txns))])\n    assert rows[1:] == expected\n=== END AC report-balances-values ===\n\n=== AC f\"{sign}{q}.{r:02d}\"\n\ncodes = [\"ZZRB4\", \"ZZRB3\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for c in codes:\n        db.accounts.create(account=c, name=\"Empty \" + c)\n    code, out, err = FEATURE-ReportCategories.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Categories\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger report categories`, per-category transaction count, inflow, outflow, and net with a total row, computed from stored data. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger report categories |\n| Consumes | ledger_core.money, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nReport totals by category, including categories with no transactions. Every value is computed from queries over stored rows. Persistence is reached only through the generated `persistence` package via `ledger_core`.\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. which changes only a transaction's amount without leaving any account balance below zero. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-BalanceRule.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn amend |\n| Consumes | ledger_core.transactions, ledger_core.validation, ledger_core.balances, cli.registry |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAmend the amount of an existing transaction. Only the amount changes; date, account, category, and memo are untouched. Persistence is reached only through `ledger_core.transactions`, which calls the generated `persistence` package.\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Argument count other than two after `txn amend` exits 2.\n2. The id must be an integer; otherwise exit 3.\n3. The amount is validated with `ledger_core.validation` (`-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, at most two decimals, never zero); a violation exits 3.\n4. An absent id exits 4.\n5. The resulting balance of the transaction's account is the stored balance minus the old amount plus the new amount, computed in integer cents through `ledger_core.balances`. A negative result exits 3 and nothing is written.\n6. Otherwise only the amount is updated and the updated row is printed as `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` with a two-decimal amount.\n7. A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md and reached through `ledger_core.transactions`.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-amend-success ===\nIntent: Amending an existing transaction exits 0, prints the updated row with the supplied amount text, and a separate read shows the new integer cents.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nimport csv\nimport io\n\ndef f(row, name):\n    return row[name] if isinstance(row, dict) else getattr(row, name)\n\nacct, cat, tid = \"ZZAM1\", \"ZZAMC1\", 900100001\nday = \"2026-05-01\"\nnewtext = \"50.00\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"amend probe\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(tid), newtext)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n    assert rows[1][0] == str(tid)\n    assert rows[1][1] == day\n    assert rows[1][4] == newtext\n    assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid), \"amount\") == int(newtext.replace(\".\", \"\"))\n=== END AC txn-amend-success ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-only-amount ===\nIntent: Amend changes only the amount; date, account, category, and memo read back exactly as they were created.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(row, name):\n    return row[name] if isinstance(row, dict) else getattr(row, name)\n\nacct, cat, tid = \"ZZAM2\", \"ZZAMC2\", 900100002\nday = \"2026-05-02\"\nnote = \"keep this memo\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=2000, memo=note)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(tid), \"35.50\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    back = db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid)\n    assert f(back, \"date\") == day\n    assert f(back, \"account\") == acct\n    assert f(back, \"category\") == cat\n    assert f(back, \"memo\") == note\n=== END AC txn-amend-only-amount ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-absent ===\nIntent: Amending an id that does not exist exits 4, prints nothing to stdout, and creates no row.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ntid = 900199999\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid) is None\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(tid), \"5.00\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid) is None\n=== END AC txn-amend-absent ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-negative-balance ===\nIntent: An amend that would leave the account balance below zero exits 3 and keeps the original amount, while an amend landing exactly on zero succeeds. \"30.00\", \"40.00\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid_in, date=\"2026-05-03\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=10000, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=tid_out, date=\"2026-05-03\", account=acct, assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid_in), \"amount\") == 10000\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(tid_in), exact)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n
